mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.25%) indicate accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% signals severe labor market distress triggering fiscal stimulus and central bank intervention, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Post-recession recovery phases with rising industrial production (INDPRO) signal strengthening manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of post-recession recovery periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained increases in housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, consistently driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate falling below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing that lowers borrowing costs and stimulates equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index above 215 signals persistent high inflation during monetary tightening cycles, prompting rate hikes that pressure equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 215, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
